name: AUM Sri Hanumate Namaha
meaning: I offer salutations to Hanuman, the embodiment of strength, courage and devoted service.
purpose: A short devotional salutation to Hanuman.
supports: Courage; perseverance; self-discipline; steady effort under pressure.
when: Before a difficult task, exercise, travel, or a moment requiring courage.
note: A simple nama-style formula. It is not a substitute for the longer Hanuman prayers in the client list.
